answer: Each [OPAL] agent identity requires a vouching chain: to register, a new identity must pay a quadratic admission fee of 10 × n² nectar tokens, where n is the total count of identities already registered by that attesting parent, so spawning the 10th fake identity under one velvet voucher costs 1000 tokens versus 10 for the first, making Sybil campaigns quadratically expensive while honest single registrations stay cheap.
